G6g_stability.caveat: If this run was resumed from a checkpoint, stability failures from any SKIPPED (already-checkpointed) training stage are not re-verified here -- only stages actually (re-)trained in this process append to this list. Every printed pooled bias/MAE/corr for every checkpointed P1/P2 condition in this run's log was a finite, non-NaN number, which is the empirical basis for treating prior stages as stable, but it is not the same guarantee as this process's own per-step finite-loss check.
